title: Relay Established Successfully
description: A pivot relay session was established between pivot-client and pivot-agent. Authentication, TLS handshake, and network profile activation all succeeded. Scanner traffic can now reach the target CIDR.
remediation: No action required. Operational success event. Ensure the session is deactivated cleanly after scanning completes.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening.
remediation_brief: Implement secure session management with proper timeout, regeneration, and invalidation. Use secure cookie flags.

title: Authentication Failed — Invalid HMAC Token
description: The AUTH message sent by a connecting client contained an HMAC-SHA256 digest that did not match the expected value for the provided nonce and shared secret. The connection was rejected.
remediation: Verify that security.auth_token matches exactly on both agent and client configurations (including whitespace). For chained profiles, ensure upstream.auth_token matches the upstream relay's token.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening.
remediation_brief: Remove hardcoded secrets from code and config. Implement a secrets management solution with rotation policies.

title: Replay Attack Detected — Nonce Already Used
description: An AUTH message was received with a nonce that has been used in a previous authentication attempt within the current session. This is indicative of a replay attack — a captured AUTH message being retransmitted.
remediation: Investigate the source IP of the replayed authentication attempt. Verify TLS is enforced end-to-end (no MitM). Rotate auth_token and regenerate TLS certificates if compromise is suspected.
impact: An attacker could potentially exploit this weakness to gain partial access, disclose sensitive information, or degrade the security posture of the affected system. Input validation failures may allow injection attacks, data manipulation, or unauthorized code execution.
remediation_brief: Implement proper input validation, output encoding, and parameterized queries. Apply security headers and content security policies.

title: TLS Handshake Failed
description: The TLS handshake between pivot-client and pivot-agent failed. Possible causes: certificate not trusted by the client's CA bundle, CN/SAN mismatch, expired certificate, or unsupported TLS version.
remediation: 1. Ensure ca.crt on the client was generated by the same CA that signed agent.crt. 2. Confirm security.tls.server_hostname in client config matches CN/SAN in agent.crt. 3. Check certificate expiry. 4. Verify TLS 1.2+ is supported on both sides.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Weak cryptographic implementations may allow interception, decryption, or forgery of protected communications.
remediation_brief: Update cryptographic configurations to current standards. Disable deprecated protocols and cipher suites. Ensure certificates are valid and properly configured.

title: Unauthorised Connection Attempt — IP Not in Allowlist
description: A connection was received from a source IP that is not present in security.allowed_peers. The connection was rejected after TLS handshake but before authentication, minimising information leakage.
remediation: Review allowed_peers in the agent configuration. If the source IP is legitimate, add it to the allowlist. Investigate unexpected connection sources.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Weak cryptographic implementations may allow interception, decryption, or forgery of protected communications.
remediation_brief: Update cryptographic configurations to current standards. Disable deprecated protocols and cipher suites. Ensure certificates are valid and properly configured.

title: iptables Rule Applied Successfully
description: iptables FORWARD and MASQUERADE rules were successfully installed on the relay device for a network profile. IP forwarding is active. Scanner traffic will be NATted to the relay's LAN IP.
remediation: No action required. Verify rule cleanup occurs on session deactivation.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Network-level vulnerabilities may allow traffic interception, lateral movement, or unauthorized service access.
remediation_brief: Restrict network access using firewalls and segmentation. Disable unnecessary services and protocols. Implement network monitoring.

title: iptables Rule Cleanup Completed
description: All iptables rules installed for a relay session were removed successfully. ip_forward was reset to its pre-session value if no other sessions are active. Relay state is fully clean.
remediation: No action required. Verify with: sudo iptables -L FORWARD -n -v and sudo iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n -v
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening.
remediation_brief: Implement secure session management with proper timeout, regeneration, and invalidation. Use secure cookie flags.

title: Relay Chain Established

remediation: No action required. Operational success event. Verify end-to-end connectivity with a test scan before the full engagement.

title: Connection to Upstream Relay Failed
description: A chained relay attempted to connect to its configured upstream relay (pivot-agent at upstream.host) but failed. The chain is broken and the target network is unreachable.
remediation: 1. Verify the upstream relay is running and reachable from the current relay device. 2. Check upstream.host and upstream.port in the profile configuration. 3. Verify auth_token, TLS certs, and network routing between relay nodes.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Network-level vulnerabilities may allow traffic interception, lateral movement, or unauthorized service access.

title: Certificate Validation Failed — Agent Certificate Not Trusted
description: The pivot-client rejected the agent's TLS certificate because it could not be validated against the configured CA bundle. This may indicate a certificate mismatch or a potential MitM attack.
remediation: Verify cafile on the client points to the CA that signed the agent's certificate. Re-generate certificates with tools/pivot-gen-certs.sh if needed. Never set verify_hostname: false in production.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Weak cryptographic implementations may allow interception, decryption, or forgery of protected communications.
remediation_brief: Update cryptographic configurations to current standards. Disable deprecated protocols and cipher suites. Ensure certificates are valid and properly configured.

title: mTLS Client Certificate Required
description: The agent is configured with require_client_cert: true (mutual TLS). Clients must present a valid certificate signed by the agent's CA in addition to HMAC token authentication.
remediation: Generate a client certificate with tools/pivot-gen-certs.sh and configure certfile/keyfile in the client's TLS configuration block.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Weak cryptographic implementations may allow interception, decryption, or forgery of protected communications.
remediation_brief: Update cryptographic configurations to current standards. Disable deprecated protocols and cipher suites. Ensure certificates are valid and properly configured.

title: HMAC Verification Failed — Token Mismatch
description: The HMAC-SHA256 digest computed from the client's nonce and the stored shared secret did not match the digest provided in the AUTH message. Authentication was denied. Constant-time comparison was used to prevent timing oracle attacks.
remediation: Verify auth_token values match exactly on both sides. If mismatches persist after verifying configs, investigate for tampering or MitM. Rotate the shared secret.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Weak cryptographic implementations may allow interception, decryption, or forgery of protected communications.
remediation_brief: Update cryptographic configurations to current standards. Disable deprecated protocols and cipher suites. Ensure certificates are valid and properly configured.

title: iptables Rule Application Failed
description: The agent could not install required iptables FORWARD or MASQUERADE rules. This prevents traffic forwarding to the target network. The relay session is non-functional.
remediation: Ensure pivot-agent is running as root or with CAP_NET_ADMIN + CAP_NET_RAW. Verify iptables is installed: which iptables. Check: sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening. Network-level vulnerabilities may allow traffic interception, lateral movement, or unauthorized service access.
remediation_brief: Restrict network access using firewalls and segmentation. Disable unnecessary services and protocols. Implement network monitoring.

title: Route Installation Failed on Scanner
description: pivot-client failed to install the OS route for the target CIDR on the scanner machine. The scanner cannot reach the target network even though the relay session is active.
remediation: Run pivot-client with sudo. On Linux: verify ip command is available. On macOS: verify route command is available and sudo rights are granted.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening.
remediation_brief: Implement secure session management with proper timeout, regeneration, and invalidation. Use secure cookie flags.

title: Session Expired — Heartbeat Timeout
description: The relay session was closed because no HEARTBEAT message was received from the client within the configured heartbeat_timeout period. The client may have crashed or the network path was interrupted.
remediation: Ensure pivot-client is running and the network path between client and agent remains stable. Adjust heartbeat_interval and heartbeat_timeout in the config if the network is lossy.
impact: An attacker could potentially exploit this weakness to gain partial access, disclose sensitive information, or degrade the security posture of the affected system.
remediation_brief: Implement secure session management with proper timeout, regeneration, and invalidation. Use secure cookie flags.

title: Maximum Concurrent Sessions Reached
description: A new connection was rejected because the agent has reached session.max_sessions. No additional relay clients can connect until an existing session is released.
remediation: Increase session.max_sessions in the agent config if additional concurrent connections are needed. Verify that existing sessions are not stuck.
impact: An attacker could potentially exploit this weakness to gain partial access, disclose sensitive information, or degrade the security posture of the affected system.

title: Protocol Message Too Large
description: A received message exceeded the maximum permitted payload size (1 MB). The connection was closed. This may indicate a malformed client, a bug, or a potential memory exhaustion attempt.
remediation: Investigate the source of the oversized message. Ensure only authorised clients connect to the relay. Review for protocol anomalies.

title: Malformed Protocol Message Received
description: A message was received that could not be parsed as valid JSON, was missing the required 'type' field, or had a zero-length payload. The connection was closed.
remediation: Investigate the source of the malformed message. This may indicate a port scanner, an incompatible client version, or an active probe. Review allowed_peers configuration.

title: sysctl ip_forward Activation Failed
description: The agent could not set net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 via sysctl. Without IP forwarding enabled, traffic cannot be relayed between the VPN and LAN interfaces.
remediation: Run pivot-agent as root. Manually verify: sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward. In some hardened environments, sysctl may be locked — consult system configuration.
impact: This finding provides informational context about the environment useful for security assessment and hardening.
remediation_brief: Apply system hardening baselines (CIS, DISA STIG). Disable unnecessary services, features, and accounts.

title: Clean Session Deactivation Completed
description: The pivot-client sent a DEACTIVATE message and the agent responded with DEACTIVATE_RESPONSE. iptables rules, kernel routes, and ip_forward were all cleaned up. Session state is fully removed.
remediation: No action required. Verify cleanup with: ip route show && iptables -L FORWARD -n -v
impact: An attacker could potentially exploit this weakness to gain partial access, disclose sensitive information, or degrade the security posture of the affected system.
remediation_brief: Implement secure session management with proper timeout, regeneration, and invalidation. Use secure cookie flags.
